 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy

4 02-02-2026 Heard learned Senior counsel for the petitioner, the State and Dr. Anand Kumar for Bihar Rajya Bridge Construction Corporation (for brevity, 'the Corporation').
2.

The present petition has been preferred for the following relief(s):
"A. The Respondents be directed to pay compensation to the Petitioner in respect of his Raiyati land bearing Plot no. 14 (old), 15 (old) 17 (new) appertaining to Khata no.
24 (old), 47 (New) having total area 3 Katha out of 14 Katha 6.5 Dhur situated at Mauza Khurunda P.S. and Anchal Hasanpur Dist. Samastipur upon which the Respondents have forcibly constructed Road Bridge without the consent of the Petitioner and Patna High Court CWJC No.15198 of 2016(4) dt.02-02-2026 without taking recourse of the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, allegedly under the Scheme of the State Government known as "Mukhyamantri Setu Nirman Yojna' within a shortest period specified by the Hon'ble Court.

B. The Respondents be further directed to pay compensation to the Petitioner amounting to Rs.
14,000/- on account of damage of Janera crops in entire 14 Katha 6.5 Dhura in the year 2014, 2015 Shambhu Prasad Yadav @ Shambhu Yadav vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129743347/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: due to work activities on land and further for the year 2016 during which the Respondents retained possession on the entire land by putting building materials thereon to the tune of Rs. 14,000/-total Rs. 42,000/-.
C. For any other relief or reliefs to which the Petitioner may be found entitled to in the facts and circumstances of the case."
3. Copies were served upon the respondents before filing of the petition in the year 2016, we are in the year 2026, but still, there is no counter-affidavit.

4. Let both the State-respondents as also 'the Corporation' file their respective affidavits in four weeks after Patna High Court CWJC No.15198 of 2016(4) dt.02-02-2026 service of copy to the learned counsel for the petitioner who shall be filing reply to it, if so wants, in two weeks.
5. Failure to file affidavit by any of the respondents, learned counsel for the petitioner shall be entitled to Rs. 3,000/- as cost.

6. List this case on 16.03.2026.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
